## Projects

**Intervyou** (Full-Stack) — AI-powered interview preparation platform with CV analysis, ATS optimization, and mock interview features. Trusted by 3,000+ users. Tech: Next.js, MySQL, PostgreSQL, Google Gemini API, TypeScript. Live: https://intervyou.me

**Transpo** (Full-Stack) — Online transportation booking platform for the Malang Raya area connecting passengers with inter-city travel services. Tech: Next.js, TypeScript, MySQL, Google Maps API, Prisma, TailwindCSS. Live: https://transpo.id

**Simakin** (Full-Stack) — AI-powered Quran memorization platform with a personal AI coach giving real-time feedback on tajweed, makhroj, and fluency with streak tracking. Tech: Remix, Prisma, MySQL, Google Gemini API, Google Cloud Platform, TailwindCSS.

**Safera** (Full-Stack) — Streaming donation platform for Indonesian content creators with transparent fees, instant bank transfers, QRIS payment, and AI-powered gambling content moderation. Tech: NestJS, Next.js, Google Gemini API, MySQL, TypeScript.

**PT Sekawan Pitu** (Full-Stack) — Company profile and e-commerce website for a free-range livestock farm in Sukabumi. Tech: Next.js, TypeScript, TailwindCSS. Live: https://pt-sekawan-pitu.vercel.app

**BIPA** (Full-Stack) — Learning Management System for structured Indonesian language teaching for foreign speakers. Tech: Laravel, React.js, TypeScript, MySQL, TailwindCSS.

**LBC Laundry** (Full-Stack) — Laundry management system for tracking orders, customers, and payments with a real-time dashboard. Tech: MongoDB, Express.js, React.js, Node.js, TailwindCSS.

**Kasirku** (Full-Stack) — Point-of-sale and cashier management app for small businesses with product management, transactions, and sales reporting. Tech: React.js, Laravel, MySQL, TailwindCSS. GitHub: https://github.com/rezadrian01/Kasirku

**SiJawi** (Frontend) — Frontend application for a Javanese cultural education platform with interactive lessons and quizzes. Tech: React.js, TypeScript, TailwindCSS, Vite.

**MERN Online Shop** (Full-Stack) — Full-featured e-commerce platform with product management, cart, and payment integration. Tech: React.js, Node.js, Express.js, MongoDB.
